parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 500 domain names in a single request.

By default, all accelerated domain names are queried.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The time granularity of the queried data. Unit: seconds. Valid values: **300**, **3600**, and **86400**.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP). Default value: all ISPs.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the region. If you do not specify this parameter, all regions are queried.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).
